text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, the property has **not** experienced any significant tree-cover loss since 2021. The assessment confirms that no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or more were detected between 2021 and 2025. While small patches of loss (under 0.5 ha) were observed in 2021, these are below the detectable threshold for the claim. The data sources used (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) provide high-confidence observations, covering the entire asset area. No loss events were recorded in the claim period (2021–2025), aligning with the "NOT_DETECTED" status.
